name: narrow-module-context-and-default-role-orchestration
changes: Added IForsettiModuleContext as the module lifecycle surface.
Migrated IForsettiModule start and stop signatures to IForsettiModuleContext.
Kept ForsettiContext as the framework-owned concrete context while exposing moduleID, services, logger, event publishing, messaging, and subscriptions through the narrow interface.
Added module-originated publishEvent with event_publishing capability enforcement and reserved namespace rejection.
Sanitized module-supplied payload fields before framework-owned source and target metadata is applied.
Added DefaultModuleCatalog and DefaultModuleOrchestrator for resolving required default roles from confirmed registration records.
Integrated required default role validation into ModuleManager activation.
testsAdded: Module-scoped context exposes module ID as a string through the narrow interface.
Module-originated event publication requires event_publishing capability.
Module messaging strips caller-supplied framework-owned payload fields.
Activation fails when required default role providers cannot be resolved.

validation.command: python3 JSON parse over repository JSON files
rg old lifecycle and optional moduleID patterns

knownLimitations: Native compile and test execution still require Windows/MSVC, CMake, CTest, vcpkg, and PowerShell.
